clusters.headline: Delhi Police Apprehend Teen For Selling Stolen Agniveer Data Online
aiSummaryBullets: A 14-year-old was apprehended by Delhi Police for hacking an Agniveer recruitment website.
The suspect reportedly utilized an AI chatbot to identify vulnerabilities and extract private information.

clusters.headline: US Report Links China Support For Pakistan To Operation Sindoor
aiSummaryBullets: A recent US congressional report claims China provided critical military and economic aid to Pakistan during Operation Sindoor.
The analysis suggests Beijing utilized these tactics to deliberately counteract India’s strategic and economic advancement in the region.

clusters.headline: Tamil Nadu Court Permits CCTV Review In Police Custody Death Case
aiSummaryBullets: A court has authorized the family of a deceased man to examine CCTV footage from a Tamil Nadu police station.
The decision follows a case involving a death that occurred while the individual was held in police custody.

clusters.headline: Indian Ministry Of Defence Finalizes INS Betwa Propulsion Upgrade
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian Ministry of Defence has entered into a formal agreement for the refitting of the INS Betwa.
The contract for the ship's maintenance and upgrade is valued at 498 crore rupees.

clusters.headline: Sonam Wangchuk Claims House Arrest Lifted Following Court Hearing
aiSummaryBullets: Sonam Wangchuk stated his house arrest, which began on November 11, has been lifted following a court hearing.
The activist has criticized the administration's governance and the scheduling of the current local government elections.

clusters.headline: BJP And Rahul Gandhi Trade Accusations Over Governance And Policy
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP criticized Rahul Gandhi for his comments on India's geopolitical standing and foreign policy, while party leaders defended India's GDP growth.
Rahul Gandhi raised concerns regarding the Manipur government's handling of alcohol-related deaths and the integrity of the Prime Minister's office.

clusters.headline: Congress Records Gains In Rajasthan Rural Elections Amid Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Congress secured notable victories in Rajasthan panchayat elections, outperforming the BJP in various rural regions and minister strongholds.
Youth Congress workers staged a protest and caused a disturbance at the Meta office in Hyderabad regarding account suspensions.

clusters.headline: Amit Shah Addresses Siang Dam Project Protests In Arunachal Pradesh
aiSummaryBullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah arrived in Arunachal Pradesh for a two-day visit amid ongoing protests against the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project.
Local groups, including Adi community organisations, have petitioned the minister regarding environmental and social concerns tied to the mega dam.

clusters.headline: Indian Cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal Joins The Bharatiya Janata Party
aiSummaryBullets: Professional cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal has formally enrolled as a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party.
The party designated the athlete as a national office bearer within its OBC Morcha division.

clusters.headline: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates The Nitish Setu Bridge In Bihar
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the six-lane, 9.76-kilometer Nitish Setu bridge spanning the Ganga river.
The infrastructure project links Kachhi Dargah in Patna to Bidupur in Vaishali and was completed at a cost of 5,500 crore rupees.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Explains Gold Purchasing Appeal Amid Economic Pressures
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that he previously requested the public to limit gold purchases to stabilize national foreign exchange reserves.
The appeal was originally made in May during a period when Middle East conflict tensions led to a significant increase in crude oil prices.

clusters.headline: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik Attends SCO Civilisations Dialogue
aiSummaryBullets: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik traveled to Delhi to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisations Dialogue Forum.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated the event serves as a platform for dialogue on civilisations rather than conflicts.

clusters.headline: Cyclone Akvan Weakens Into Depression As Heavy Rains Hit Odisha
aiSummaryBullets: Cyclone Akvan has dissipated into a depression, though lingering weather systems continue to bring heavy rainfall to parts of Odisha and West Bengal.
Local administrations in Andhra Pradesh are managing water release from reservoirs following flooding in districts including Srikakulam.

clusters.headline: Akhilesh Yadav Discusses UP Alliance Amidst Shifting Party Politics
aiSummaryBullets: Akhilesh Yadav is negotiating seat-sharing arrangements with Congress and other opposition parties for upcoming Uttar Pradesh elections.
Congress is intensifying its focus on a caste census in Uttar Pradesh to address concerns about its representation of OBC leaders.

clusters.headline: PM Narendra Modi Commemorates Platinum Jubilee At IIT Kharagpur
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the Platinum Jubilee celebrations marking 75 years of IIT Kharagpur.
The Prime Minister encouraged students to overcome limiting beliefs to contribute to national growth.

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Mourns Mother As Election Commission Seeks Answers
aiSummaryBullets: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath performed the final funeral rites for his mother, Savitri Devi, who died at the age of 91.
The Independent SIR Commission has requested formal evidence from Adityanath regarding his claims about the exclusion of 1.27 crore Hindu voters.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Very Poor To Severe Categories
aiSummaryBullets: Most monitoring stations in Delhi continue to record air quality levels classified as very poor or severe.
Specific locations including IIT-Delhi have reported air quality index readings exceeding 400.

clusters.headline: Twenty Four People Die Following Bus Collision In Assam India
aiSummaryBullets: At least 24 individuals were killed after a minibus and a trailer truck collided in the Indian state of Assam.
Casualties include several children, college students, and the bus driver, according to government officials.

clusters.headline: Amul And Mother Dairy Milk Price Hikes Continue Amid Market Shifts
aiSummaryBullets: Amul and Mother Dairy implemented price increases of up to 4 to 6 rupees per litre for milk products starting in mid-November.
Onion production has been negatively impacted by drought conditions, resulting in retail prices reaching 70 rupees per kilogram.

clusters.headline: Recent Kerala High Court Rulings On Legal And Administrative Issues
aiSummaryBullets: The Kerala High Court expressed concerns regarding delayed financial audits at the Guruvayur Devaswom Board.
Judges clarified that repaying a loan does not absolve an individual of charges filed under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act.
